guarantees: All three handlers authorize the actual IPC sender and main frame. Each request is bound to that exact WebContents/frame and a fixed host run.
The host reads getRun before and after waits. The baseline adapter performs the last synchronous guard after durable budget reserve/started and before the authorized send.
Renderer headers, including Authorization, never enter the start event. No getKey method, server, profile read or credential store write exists in this transport.
Success/error Eventa returns contain only request ID, bounded status/code, normalized content type and bounded base64 response chunks. Native causes and provider headers are not returned.
A pre-cancelled request ID stays consumed. Client abort rejects before a pending start finishes. Its abort and failure paths send cancellation. Consumed IDs reject any delayed start.
Each active request has a 30-second idle/start limit and a 120-second total limit, plus a 50ms authority watchdog. Navigation/destroy events revoke immediately.
At most 8 active requests, 256 consumed IDs per host lifetime, 8MiB response bytes per request and 64KiB per returned chunk. Completed/cancelled IDs cannot be reused.
Only arm airi is accepted. Aimy continues its existing gate. Each baseline actual HTTP has one adapter/ledger attempt.
dispose unregisters only its three invoke handlers and cancels owned requests. Other app Eventa handlers stay available.
coverage: First SSE chunk delivered before completion and settlement; key injected only in host closure is absent from both Eventa directions and ledger.
Epoch change during preparation has zero sends/reservations. Aimy arm rejected.
Pre-cancel before start and client abort while start waits have zero sends.
Sibling authorized sender cannot read/cancel another owner; subframes rejected.
Concurrent read rejected without consuming another chunk.
Reader cancellation aborts native HTTP and preserves unknown fee.
Native stream Error canary becomes bounded stream-failed and is absent from Eventa.
64KiB chunks and 8MiB cap; oversized body halts with unknown fee.
Main-frame navigation and destroyed sender revoke pending authorization.
Timeout clock fixture stops stalled preparation. Unrelated Eventa handler still works after dispose.
